measurement_semantics.derived: Calculated from measured fields without inventing missing counters.
measurement_semantics.engine_reported: Reported directly by a serving engine metrics endpoint or log.
measurement_semantics.estimated: Planning estimate from static analysis or formulas; not measured telemetry.
measurement_semantics.measured: Captured from saved run, engine, evaluator, or telemetry artifacts.
measurement_semantics.unavailable: Not captured and not derivable from current artifacts.

performance.description: Latency, queueing, throughput, and batch efficiency metrics.

request_lifecycle.description: Nullable per-request timing events; runtimes emit only what they expose.

run_identity.description: Stable run and scenario identity fields.

acceptance_evidence: route improves latency/cost while protected metrics pass
optimizations.derivation_method: Historical route comparisons can inform planning but not route decisions.
optimizations.hypothesis: Cache-aware/workload-aware routing can improve ttft, throughput, cache_hit_rate only if its mechanism is instrumented and protected quality gates pass.
optimizations.mechanism: Improve cache locality and reduce mixed-length interference.
optimizations.problem_statement: Requests are not yet routed by cache affinity or workload shape.
rejection_evidence: routing harms quality or creates unfair route drift

acceptance_evidence: long-prompt TTFT improves without short-request regression
optimizations.derivation_method: Length-bucket opportunity can be estimated; chunk events cannot.

vllm.chunked_prefill_enabled: startup flag plus engine iteration metrics

optimizations.hypothesis: If long prefills are chunked appropriately, long-request TTFT improves while decode continues for shorter requests.
optimizations.mechanism: Interleave long-prefill requests with decode work.
optimizations.problem_statement: Long context can increase TTFT and interfere with decode work if prefill is not balanced.
optimizations.sampling_frequency: per request and per engine iteration
optimizations.temporal_resolution: request length bucket and scheduler iteration

optimizations.derivation_method: No distributed serving layer exists in current artifacts.

optimizations.problem_statement: Scale serving across workers, queues, and admission control.
rejection_evidence: complexity or cost outweighs SLO benefit

optimizations.derivation_method: Formula estimates may be produced from tokens and model config only.

acceptance_evidence: kernel bottleneck reduced with end-to-end benefit
